mode: Read-only security audit; no application, workflow, lockfile or dependency edits and no browsers launched.

findings.classification: Trusted build-template hardening and startup robustness, not current visitor-triggerable XSS
findings.status: Resolved in subsequent authorized build-only patch; see security-buildguard.json.
findings.description: Regex parsing confuses data-src/data-id with actual attributes, treats comments as executable scripts and hashes the wrong body boundary when an attribute contains >. The claimed fixed startup-script inventory can therefore accept unexpected markup or miss startup failures.
impactLimits: Published content is escaped before insertion; neither query parameters nor local search can inject these raw tags.
Injected unowned scripts without a matching CSP hash remain blocked by the runtime policy.
Changing repository HTML or build code already requires trusted source access; do not report this as an unauthenticated visitor exploit.
findings.necessaryFix: Tokenize actual HTML tags/attributes while respecting comments, raw text and quoted attribute values. Match real id/src keys, enforce the owned inline-script inventory, and reject actual inline handlers without rejecting escaped plain-text examples. Validate unexpected external scripts according to the intended build inventory.

findings.status: not changed; existing workflow permission boundary retained
findings.description: Official GitHub Actions are referenced by mutable major-version tags rather than immutable commit SHAs. npm ci and lockfile integrity protect a different boundary; they do not pin action source. No compromised action was identified.
findings.recommendation: Consider a separately authorized workflow-maintenance change to pin reviewed action commits and configure automated update review.

declaredLockSupplyChain.note: Checks lock declarations only; does not assert fresh npm tarball/signature or installed-file verification.

reviewedSafeBoundaries.name: Content links and assets
reviewedSafeBoundaries.result: HTTPS/no-credentials URLs, strict GitHub profile normalization, relative raster media validation and actual section-fragment navigation remain shared by React/static rendering.

reviewedSafeBoundaries.name: HTML/text sinks
reviewedSafeBoundaries.result: Escaped source content, inert fallback snapshot and deterministic fixed particle markup are the sources of HTML sinks; no query-to-innerHTML path was found.

reviewedSafeBoundaries.name: Query/search
reviewedSafeBoundaries.result: Route switches are explicit, numeric options bounded, search is literal and limited to eight results, input maxLength120; no requests or regex evaluation use query text.

reviewedSafeBoundaries.name: Clipboard
reviewedSafeBoundaries.result: User-triggered plain-text write only; no read API or automatic background clipboard operation found.

hostingLimits: Meta CSP cannot enforce frame-ancestors or host-controlled response headers.
style-src unsafe-inline and img-src data are existing compatibility allowances; no script unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval allowance is present.
No browser enforcement or hosted-header check was performed during this phase because root reserved browser performance measurements.
No complete npm audit was possible under current network policy; fresh official GitHub exact-version lookups have their own stated limits.
